# Notices and errors

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-notice-docs.mjs from src/notices.ts and src/errors.ts; do not edit. -->

## Notices

A notice is something a command did on your behalf that the input did not say: a value changed, a result narrowed, a request that had nothing to act on. It never fails a command. Commands that can produce one add a `notices` array to their JSON (and nothing when there is nothing to say); match on `code`, not on the message.

```json
{ "code": "N_SCALE_SNAP", "severity": "warn", "message": "...", "pointer": "/layers/0/source/pitch", "requested": 466, "applied": "A#4", "hint": "..." }
```

`severity` is `warn` when the caller may be acting on a false belief and `info` when the output is merely narrower than it looks. `pointer`, `requested` and `applied` are present when they apply.

| Code | Severity | Meaning | What to do |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `N_SCALE_SNAP` | warn | A pitched layer renders at a different pitch than written, because the project scale snaps pitches to its notes. | write a pitch that is in the scale, change the scale in .agent-beeps/project.json, or set scale.snap to false to render pitches as written |
| `N_VARIANTS_IDENTICAL` | warn | The patch declares several variants, but nothing in its variation block changes the sound, so every variant renders the same samples. | add variation.pitchCents (needs a pitched layer) or variation.gainDb, or author sibling patches that differ |
| `N_NO_VARIANTS` | info | Variants were requested for a patch that declares no variants, so one render was made. | declare variation.variants in the patch (see the beeps-compose skill) before asking for variants |
| `N_SHORT_SET` | warn | A command returned fewer candidates than were asked for, because the rest failed to render or broke an error-level craft rule. | read report.dropped for each candidate and why, then rerun with another --seed or a looser prompt; do not describe the set as the size you asked for |
| `N_STEERING_CANCELLED` | info | The prompt asked for opposite things (brighter and darker, shorter and longer), so neither steered the selection. | keep one of the two words in the prompt, or pick candidates by looking at the sheet |
| `N_STEERING_UNUSED` | info | The prompt was read as directions, but the usable candidate pool was no larger than the set, so there was nothing to choose between and steering changed nothing. | ask for a smaller --count, or generate again; use mutate --toward to move a chosen candidate in a direction |
| `N_OPTION_IGNORED` | warn | An option was accepted but had no effect, because what it configures already exists. | edit the existing file (for example .agent-beeps/project.json) to change it |
| `N_TRIM_CLAMPED` | warn | The loudness trim the sound needs is further than the pipeline allows, so it was held at the limit and the sound sits above or below its loudness target. | a sound that far from the target is usually mis-gained: raise or lower its loudest layer (gainDb), or check that it is not near-silent or extremely loud |
| `N_INPUT_CLAMPED` | warn | A runtime input value was outside its declared range, so the nearest end of the range was used. | pass a value inside the input's declared min and max, or widen the range in the patch's xRuntime block |
| `N_KIT_REPLACED` | warn | Adding a sound replaced an entry of the same name in the project kit, and the replaced entry carried a value that is now different or gone. | read replaced for the previous priority, trim and seed; add with --priority to set the priority you want |
| `N_NAME_SHADOWED` | warn | A project patch or song has the same name as a library one, so the library entry is hidden and the project one is used. | rename the project entry if you meant the library one, or call the library entry by a name it does not share |
| `N_UNKNOWN_KEY` | warn | A document had a key that its schema does not know, so the key was ignored and whatever it was meant to set kept its default. A misspelled key looks exactly like this. | check the spelling against the format reference; from 0.25.0 an unknown key is an E_SCHEMA error instead of a notice |
| `N_PATTERN_TRUNCATED` | warn | A pattern is longer than the section that plays it, so the notes past the end of the section were cut off and never sound. | lengthen the section, shorten the pattern, or split the pattern so its tail has a section to play in |
| `N_DELAY_TAIL_CAPPED` | info | The feedback tail of a delay is longer than the render keeps (8 seconds), so the end of the tail was cut. | lower the delay feedback or time, or accept that the tail ends at 8 seconds |

## Errors

A failure is an error on stderr, `{ "error": { "code", "category", "retryable", "message", ... } }`, with exit code 1 (2 for a usage error caught while parsing options). `pointer` names the field at fault, `hint` says what to do, and `received` echoes the rejected value (cut to 80 characters). `category` says who has to act: change your input, repair the environment, accept the outcome, retry, or report a bug.

| Code | Category | Retryable |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `E_USAGE` | input | no |
| `E_SCHEMA` | input | no |
| `E_NOT_FOUND` | input | no |
| `E_CONFLICT` | input | no |
| `E_PROJECT` | input | no |
| `E_PREDICTION_REQUIRED` | input | no |
| `E_BUDGET` | input | no |
| `E_BROWSER_MISSING` | environment | no |
| `E_RUNTIME_MISSING` | environment | no |
| `E_TOOLCHAIN` | environment | no |
| `E_RENDER` | outcome | no |
| `E_VERIFY` | outcome | no |
| `E_NONDETERMINISTIC` | outcome | no |
| `E_LOCK` | transient | yes |
| `E_SERVER` | transient | yes |
| `E_STORE` | transient | yes |
| `E_INTERNAL` | bug | no |
